title: Clique number and triangle densities in $C_4$-free graphs
summary: For a $C_4$-free graph $G$ on $n$ vertices --- one with no induced cycle on four vertices --- we study the two-sided extremal problem for the triangle density $τ$: How large and how small can $τ$ be for given edge density $\varepsilon$ and clique-number density $κ= ω(G)/n$? We give lower and upper bounds for $τ$ in terms of $κ$ and $\varepsilon$. The two bounds sandwich $τ$, and their compatibility forces a lower bound for $κ$ in terms of $\varepsilon$.
